segment.source: ::Your approach to the two Faceless guards is met neither with words of greeting nor a gesture to stop - or even to drive you away - but is met with an immediate outburst of indiscriminate aggression.::<end>
segment.target: ::Your approach to the two Faceless guards is met neither with words of greeting nor a gesture to stop - or even to drive you away - but is met with an immediate outburst of indiscriminate aggression.::<end>

segment.source: ::As soon as your presence becomes known to the two Faceless guards, they raise their weapons in unison, ready to use them. But suddenly, they freeze. The hallway becomes noiseless; even when the two guards lower their weapons you hear no talking nor notice any visible signals between them. Several seconds pass before one of them turns around.::<end>
